review_description: We approached a number of Solar companies and found they were either just about to go under or just starting up so did not have reliable backgrounds. You need to do a lot of research on quality of panels and also be aware of the reliability of the installer. ACT Renewable Energy always use the one installation company which is Nicholas Lyons an accredited installer. We rate this company a 5. You can always get a better price which might come with cheaper panels.
